organs.authority_boundary: Recomputes the claimed integer fields exactly for one finite set and base, and rejects a forged denominator or order, an empty support, a base below two and the degenerate unit denominator. A pass is an exact computation for that one input.
organs.authority_ceiling: Recomputes the claimed integer fields exactly for one finite set and base, and rejects a forged denominator or order, an empty support, a base below two and the degenerate unit denominator. A pass is an exact computation for that one input.
organs.card: For a finite set of positive integers F and base b ≥ 2, the component computes the exact rational sum S = Σ 1/(bⁿ − 1) = P/Q.
